summary: Backend-only verification of the /api/products deploy-safe fallback + storefront listings test-artifact filter. All 6 pytest cases pass; live-endpoint spot checks confirm no regression on the healthy preview env (total=4512 unchanged, fallback short-circuits) and the store filter correctly hides Stripe-removal/TEST_/FollowNotifTest artifacts while preserving real listings.

minor.issue: Query(default=..., regex=...) triggers PendingDeprecationWarning under Pydantic v2 — use `pattern=` instead (routers/products.py:845)
FastAPI on_event deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers

critical_code_review_comments: The fallback uses count_documents({'is_active': True}) < 100 as trigger threshold — good defensive guard. Confirmed short-circuit on preview (4512 products) where the fallback path is never entered (test_products_healthy_env_untouched drift < 200).
_listing_to_product_shape correctly maps status='sold' → is_active=False + in_stock=False so the OOS badge renders when fallback surfaces sold items.

$nor filter on /api/stores/{slug}/listings uses case-insensitive regex for 'stripe removal', 'test_', 'follow notif test' — verified 56555665 now returns 0 items instead of leaking 5 Stripe-removal test titles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fallback in /api/products is a NO-OP on preview (products>=100). To exercise the augmentation path you must point MONGO_URL at a DB with <100 active products (e.g. mercariglobals deployed env) or temporarily flip the threshold. Live curl checks: preview total=4512, eddy-boss=13 listings, 56555665=0 (filter works).
rca of the issue: Deployed backend (mercariglobals.com) is on a different Mongo DB than preview. Its `products` collection has ~2 items while `listings` has ~611. Fix (already applied by main agent): /api/products augments with active seller listings when active products < 100; and /api/stores/{slug}/listings excludes legacy Stripe-removal / TEST_ / FollowNotifTest test artifacts. Verified via 6 pytests + live curl on preview.
